label: Enabled Toggle
depicts: Toggle track with one large right circle fused into one short capsule on the left
use_when: Use when the interface wants the right toggle drawn as a fused shape with the knob swelling out from the track.
avoid_when: Do not use for the capsule toggle when the switch should stay a full outline with the knob parked inside.

label: Enabled Toggle
depicts: Long capsule outline with one inner circle knob parked on the right side
use_when: Use when the interface wants the right toggle to keep the full capsule outline with the knob sitting inside it.
avoid_when: Do not use for the fused right toggle when the knob should not bulge out as part of the outer track shape.

label: Tornado
depicts: Spiral funnel body with one wide top ring narrowing into one pointed lower stem
use_when: Use when the interface wants the tornado to read as a spinning funnel body rather than stacked straight bars.
avoid_when: Do not use for the bar tornado when the weather cue should taper through horizontal bars instead of one spiral funnel.

label: Tornado
depicts: Stack of five descending horizontal bars tapering from long at top to short at bottom
use_when: Use when the interface wants the tornado simplified into horizontal bars that taper downward.
avoid_when: Do not use for the spiral funnel when the storm cue should not curl into one rounded cone body.

label: Translate
depicts: Open square frame with two short bars on the left and one small plus cross near the lower right
use_when: Use when the interface wants the translation cue to read as a framed text area with a small add mark.
avoid_when: Do not use for the letter based translate mark when the icon should center on one slanted A shape and stroke group.
